'''May 2000 San Diego tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in San Diego, California on 27 May 2000. It is known from Ryan Hase's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d888">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-13-san-diego-california-5-27-00d888/ san-diego-california-5-27-00], DeckTech (Ryan "heinekin" Hase, 13 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-13-san-diego-california-5-27-00d888/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 May 2000
* '''Site:''' San Diego, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
